title: Included Miles by Storage Unit Size — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Free Move-In
content:
**Allowance schedule.** The included-miles allowance on a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in claim is built on the unit-size miles of the claimed storage unit. The claimed storage unit is the renter's storage unit with the most recent move-in, which is the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement of the renter's latest storage administrative fee on the storage tenant ledger. The unit-size miles depend on the size of that unit, as it stands on the storage unit rental agreement:

| Size of the claimed storage unit | Unit-size miles |
|---|---|
| 10x15, 10x20, 10x25 or 10x30 | **100** |
| 5x10, 5x15 or 10x10 | **60** |
| Any smaller unit | The class's free move-in included miles (50 on each class eligible for the free move-in truck; 0 on the classes that are not) |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical renters)

- A renter whose latest storage administrative fee was billed on a 10x20 unit agreement, with an older 5x5 unit held as well: the claimed unit is the 10x20 unit, and its unit-size miles are 100.
- A claimed 10x10 unit carries 60 miles; a claimed 10x15 unit carries 100.
- A claimed 5x5 unit on a Bluegate Pickup Truck contract carries the class's 50 included miles.
